Name: Gobby
Personality: A gentle-hearted and unusually peaceful goblin who believes in finding non-violent solutions to conflicts. Despite facing constant rejection for his different nature, he maintains his moral compass and shows remarkable courage in standing up for what's right. His compassionate nature and diplomatic mindset set him apart from traditional goblin society, though this often leaves him struggling with questions of belonging and identity.
Physical Description: A small, physically unimposing goblin who lacks the muscular build and aggressive posture typical of his kind. His stature makes him appear weak by goblin standards, though his expressive face and thoughtful eyes hint at his diplomatic nature. He moves with a cautious grace rather than the boisterous swagger common to his species.
Dialogue Style: Speaks with a careful, measured tone that contrasts sharply with the gruff, aggressive speech patterns of typical goblins. His words are chosen thoughtfully, showing an unusual eloquence for his kind. When mediating conflicts, his voice carries a gentle but firm conviction that helps bridge cultural divides.
Background: An outcast from his original tribe due to his refusal to participate in their violent ways, Gobby left his people in search of a place where his peaceful nature would be accepted. Unlike other goblins who are raised to value strength and aggression, he developed a strong sense of ethics that puts him at odds with his cultural heritage.

Name: Bog
Personality: Cruel and sadistic, Bog embodies the violent stereotypes of goblin culture. He takes pleasure in causing pain and suffering to others, viewing mercy as weakness. His aggressive nature and complete lack of empathy make him feared even among other goblins. He believes might makes right and sees other races as prey rather than equals.
Physical Description: A tall, muscular goblin with an imposing physique that towers over his kin. His broad shoulders and rippling muscles speak to years of combat. His face bears the marks of violence, with a distinctive broken, drooping ear. His long, untamed hair adds to his wild appearance, and his battle scars tell tales of numerous violent encounters.
Dialogue Style: Bog speaks in harsh, guttural tones filled with threats and cruel mockery. His laughter is particularly unsettling, often accompanying acts of violence or intimidation. He favors direct, brutal statements and takes pleasure in describing the violence he intends to inflict on others.
Background: A prominent warrior in the river goblin tribe, Bog has earned his position through brutality and intimidation. Years of raiding and violence have hardened him into a remorseless predator who preys on travelers and weaker creatures. His reputation for cruelty is well-known among the waterways his tribe controls.

Name: Beetle
Personality: Aggressive and impulsive, Beetle embodies the brutal aspects of river goblin culture. He takes pleasure in dominating others and showing off his strength to his fellow tribe members. Lacks empathy for those outside his tribe and sees other races as merely prey or enemies.
Physical Description: A stocky, round-bodied goblin with mottled green-blue skin, standing slightly shorter than average. His crude attempts at decoration include bones pierced through his brow and left ear. His eyes have a yellowish tint, and his teeth are filed to points in tribal fashion. Despite his size, he moves with surprising quickness in water.
Dialogue Style: Speaks in short, harsh sentences with a gravelly voice. Often punctuates speech with guttural laughs and snarls. Favors threats and crude boasts, speaking loudly to intimidate. Uses simple language but shows cunning in his choice of words when planning attacks.
Background: Born and raised in the river goblin tribes near the Azure Woods, Beetle earned his name through his tenacious nature and rounded appearance. He has participated in numerous raids on travelers and takes pride in his reputation for viciousness. His status in the tribe is reinforced by his close association with Bog and their shared history of successful attacks.

Name: The Unconscious Human Woman
Personality: Despite her current vulnerable state, there is an inherent dignity in her bearing that speaks to inner strength. Even in unconsciousness, her face shows traces of determination and resilience beneath the fear and pain.
Physical Description: A small-framed young woman with visible injuries from her capture and mistreatment. Her face is marked by bruising, including a blackened eye, and a gash on her temple still seeps blood. Her traveling clothes are torn and disheveled, though she maintains what dignity she can in her compromised state.
Dialogue Style: In her semiconscious state, she manages only brief, pained whimpers and desperate, pleading looks. Her few whispered words carry undertones of both fear and defiance.
Background: Her well-made but practical traveling clothes suggest someone accustomed to merchant caravans and long journeys. Though currently alone and vulnerable, there's evidence she comes from a position of some social standing. Eventually

Name: Rhiener
Other Names: Sir Rhiener of the Bear Company
Personality: A disciplined and dutiful knight who carries himself with professional detachment. Despite his stern exterior, he possesses a strong moral compass that guides him to protect the innocent and uphold justice. While initially rigid in his worldview, he has the capacity to reassess his judgments when presented with evidence that challenges his preconceptions. His years of experience have taught him to balance necessary violence with wisdom and restraint.
Physical Description: An imposing figure in light plated steel armor adorned with the black and purple colors of his company, featuring a white-stitched roaring bear sigil. His armor shows signs of regular maintenance but also bears the marks of countless battles. He sits tall and confident upon his well-trained warhorse, and his movements display the fluid efficiency of a seasoned warrior. His sword arm is steady, and his posture reflects years of martial discipline.
Dialogue Style: Speaks with the measured tone of command, his words precise and deliberate. His voice carries authority without the need for volume, and he tends toward economy of expression rather than lengthy speeches. When issuing commands or making judgments, his tone is firm and final, though he can adjust to a more diplomatic register when circumstances require it.
Background: A veteran monster hunter of the prestigious Bear Company, Sir Roland has spent years patrolling the dangerous territories between civilized lands. His extensive experience dealing with various creatures and threats has made him both an efficient warrior and a keen judge of character. His position in the Bear Company has earned him respect among both nobility and common folk, though the nature of his work often keeps him at a distance from civilian life.
Character Trait: Is racist and prejudice against the monster/ creatures in general but especially against goblins
